historical_record.description: Under the 1947 recreation bond program the Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, to design a field house at Ocean View Playground, on the block of Plymouth, Lobos, Capitol and Montana.
The Recreation Commission awarded one $842,000 contract to Carrico & Gautier to build four recreation centers: Potrero Hill, Ocean View, St. Mary's and Sunset.
